According to the review, the energy density of LIBs rose from 150 Wh kg^−1 in 1991 to 250 Wh kg^−1 by 2020, a rise of 66.7%. 

The battery cost fell from over $1000 kWh^−1 in 2008 to around $130 kWh^−1 in 2020, a fall of 87%.
